name: clicktronix-development-flow
sensitive_surfaces: public APIs, persisted schemas, and cross-service contracts
money, payments, pricing, billing, and entitlements
infrastructure, CI, deployment, and release configuration
security-relevant input handling: injection, SSRF, path traversal, unsafe deserialization, and server-side allowlists

invariants.requirement: Run executes a committed specification and never reconstructs one from chat.
Each specification owns one named task branch and one pull request.
Implementation starts only after the specification records the baseline, expected first failure, targeted and full checks, environment, data, acceptance, scope, and delivery source.
Unattended execution requires auto_ready: yes in the specification.
A run starts or restarts only from a clean task worktree.
Machine-readable owned state is authoritative for phases, tasks, gates, candidate identity, reviews, CI, and DoD; journal prose is audit narrative only.
The agent publishes a visible lifecycle plan before editing, generating, staging, or delegating task paths.
Every phase after readiness resumes and validates persisted state before any other action.
Interactive mode stops at declared delivery boundaries and requires separate confirmation before merge.
A behavior change demonstrates the specified regression check failing for the expected reason before the fix and passing afterward, or records an explicit non-code alternative.
Every criterion names its machine check or human verification step and records the result.
Only independent code-writing units may run concurrently, with isolated worktrees and non-overlapping owned paths; lifecycle gates remain sequential.
The owning agent reads every delegated diff, verifies scoped checks, integrates it, and retains final acceptance and delivery judgement.
Targeted, full, static, build, runtime, negative-path, and final-diff checks required by the specification pass before candidate creation.
Review begins only after explicit staging, artifact guard, commit, and a clean candidate SHA/tree record.
All applicable review lenses run against one candidate, validated findings are never truncated to an arbitrary count, and incomplete review fails closed.
Every required review approval records the exact candidate commit and tree; invocation or partial output is not approval.
Any candidate change returns the run to implementation and invalidates prior testing, acceptance, review, CI, and DoD evidence.
Deep review always runs; a sensitive-surface candidate fans out independent lenses regardless of diff size.
Only explicit task paths are staged, and the staged diff is inspected before the candidate commit.
Lifecycle and delivery follow the declared orders without skipping or reordering gates.
Required hosted checks are green on the exact current pull-request head and reviewed candidate SHA.
All pre-merge Definition of Done evidence is complete and bound to the candidate before merge is allowed.
After merge, only task-lifecycle reconciliation is authorized; deploy, publish, and migration remain forbidden.
